The median return on equity over 5 years at 28% [E37] suggests a strong historical performance. However, the recent year's median return on equity of -2% [E20] indicates significant challenges that have not yet normalized. This discrepancy implies that while the company has a robust long-term track record, it is currently facing substantial operational issues that are impacting its short-term financial health. The low ROE over the last year [E19] and the negative median return on equity for the same period [E20] suggest ongoing difficulties in generating adequate returns for shareholders. These findings indicate that despite a strong historical performance, Studio LSD Ltd is currently underperforming and requires closer scrutiny to understand its current challenges before fully appreciating its value.
